mechanism: Pyrazinamide competes with methotrexate for renal tubular secretion and may decrease methotrexate clearance, increasing methotrexate toxicity and reducing pyrazinamide efficacy through competition for uric acid excretion.
action: Monitor methotrexate levels closely, assess for signs of toxicity (myelosuppression, hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity), and consider alternative tuberculosis therapy if possible; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
